The '''Halbara system''' was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="BoP" /> within the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Halbara/Legends|Halbara]].<ref name="PotG3" />

A [[Battle of Halbara/Legends|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place in the system during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BoP" />
